facts.fact: WeAreTech Africa reports that the government recently issued an ordinance on digitalisation (an ordinance made by the Head of State, an executive instrument with legal force); the article gives no ordinance number and no date of issue, so as_of is the article's published date.

WeAreTech Africa reports that the ordinance mandates public administrations to digitise services and interconnect systems; the article gives no number for the ordinance and no date of issue, so as_of is the article's published date.
